name: To Love-Ru: Doki Doki! Rinkai Gakkou-hen
original_name: To LOVEる -とらぶる-ドキドキ! 臨海学校編
source:
Rito and the To Love Ru cast are sent to an academy by the sea. With so many girls in bikinis Rito's luck, for once, is going to change for the better. Or so he believes. Taking his chance, he closes in on Haruna, his long time crush and hope to be able to complete his confession.

However, more trouble awaits him as more alien girls are going to appear together with their traps. Like all romance simulation games, you win the girls' hearts by raising their level of awareness for you. Pay them compliments, depending on what you say, their expressions and the event scenes you will receive differs.

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9f-49-jp-70-2sng.html]Play Asia[/url]]
translation:
梨斗与《出包王女》的一众角色来到海边学校。身边有这么多穿着泳装的少女，梨斗心想，自己的运气这次总该变好了。至少他本人是这样认为的。他抓住机会接近长久以来暗恋的春菜，希望终于能够完成告白。

然而，更多麻烦正等待着他：新的外星少女将带着各式陷阱接连登场。与其他恋爱模拟游戏一样，玩家需要提高少女对自己的好感来赢得芳心。根据称赞她们时选择的话语不同，角色表情和触发的事件场景也会发生变化。

[摘自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9f-49-jp-70-2sng.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
